rationale: The agent found that case status is confounded with plate and run date. It measured the imbalance at about 85% of cases on plates 1-2 versus about 15% of controls, and found that plate alone gives an AUROC of 0.78, which is close to the key's ~0.82. It showed that training on one batch and testing on the other falls to chance, rejected the 0.82 as a disease signature, and recommended re-running with cases and controls balanced across plates.
